card.name: Start of a drug name after a small word
card.fires_on: A short word or single letter (i, I, a, of, or) that sits just before a drug or product name or class term, such as ipecac, iodine, IMLYGIC, IUS or progestogen. It is often the first letter of the name itself.

modes.description: A single i or I that begins a drug or product name, split from the rest of the word.

modes.description: The word a, of or or right before a drug or hormone term in dosing text.
